tutorials.title: Multiworld Setup Guide
tutorials.description: A guide for setting up Memories in Orbit to be played in Archipelago.

readme.text:
# MIO Archipelago Client
The multiworld randomizer client for the game MIO: Memories in Orbit.

## Setup
For those who would like a video tutorial, one can be found [here](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Zl-Z8Y7YIqU).

1. MAKE SURE DOTNET 8 IS INSTALLED!!!
2. Install the [mod loader](https://github.com/MIO-Modding/mod-loader)
3. Run the game, and then close it
4. Download the most recent zip from releases and put it's contents in your mods folder. The path should look something like "MIO/mods/MioAP/MioAP.dll"

## Running
1. Run the game
2. Press F1 (can be rebound in mod settings)
3. Enter your connection info and press connect
4. Make a new save

## Found a bug or want to request a feature?
We use the GitHub issue tracker to manage bugs and features. Please check that your bug/feature doesn't already have an issue before creating one. You can view and create issues [here](https://github.com/ShackledMars261/mio-archipelago/issues). 

## Contributing
### First Time Setup
1. Clone the repository via Git
2. Run this command to setup the commit hooks:
```
git config core.hooksPath .githooks
```

### Working on the Mod
1. Find an issue you'd like to work on [here](https://github.com/ShackledMars261/mio-archipelago/issues). If there isn't an issue for what you'd like to work on, please create one.
2. Add yourself as the assignee of the issue by commenting `/assign`. This will automatically create a new branch and draft PR for you to work from.
3. Work off of the created branch, and when your changes are ready, create a PR to merge it into main.
4. Your PR will need to be reviewed before being merged into main. If there are any unresolved comments on your PR, please work with the reviewer to fix what they pointed out. ONLY THE REVIEWER/USER WHO LEFT THE COMMENT ORIGINALLY SHOULD RESOLVE IT! NOT YOU! Once all comments are resolved, they will re-review.
5. Once your PR has been reviewed and approved, you can merge it into main! This will automatically close the issue and delete the branch.
6. Congrats! You've fixed a bug with the mod.

### Release Checklist
- [ ] Make sure all files in ./lib are up-to-date
- [ ] Generate fresh client/world.json, and copy to respective locations
- [ ] Build APWorld file
- [ ] Push both repositories (client and world)
- [ ] Push version tag to client repo
- [ ] Wait for release to build
- [ ] Upload APWorld file
- [ ] Upload devsheet.xlsx to release (for interactive map)
- [ ] Fix release description saying actions bot is the author of all PRs
- [ ] Publish release
